content.title: See the full Coachella 2026 schedule and livestream details: weekend one
content.text: Follow the Fader Music Style Culture Video Magazine Events Shop US Edition UK Edition Canada Edition Photo by Kevin Winter/Getty Images for Coachella It's time for weekend one of Coachella 2026 with highly anticipated performances from Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G It all kicks off on Friday, April 10, with performances from Slayyyter The xx, Dijon, Ninajirachi, Dijon, and more. Carpenter will play her headlining set, bringing her signature slapstick humor and falsetto to the dessert stage. Saturday will be the much hyped Bieberchella with Bieber seemingly set to perform a throwback set. Also playing live on Saturday will be Addison Rae, Alex G, Pinkpantheress, The Strokes, Geese, and rusowsky, among others. The festival concludes Sunday with Karol G taking the stage. Elsewhere, there will be performances from Young Thug, Laufey, Wet Leg, Model/Actriz, Oklou, FKA Twigs, and more. As usual, you'll be able to stream Coachella 2025 on your phone, computer, or TV using the YouTube app or Coachella's website. The livestream starts Friday, April 10, at 4 p.m. PT/7 p.m ET with seven concurrent livestreams covering the festival's different stages. There will also be a multiview cam that allows you to watch four streams at once, toggling between each to hear audio. Every day’s exact performance times are usually announced the morning of, but most sets are expected to be streamed. Coachella Stage set times: Friday:Anyma (12:00 p.m.)The xx (7:00-7:55 p.m.)Teddy Swims (5:30-6:20 p.m.)Record Safari (4:15-5:20 p.m.) Saturday:Justin Bieber (11:25 p.m.)The Strokes (9:00-10:10 p.m.)GIVĒON (7:00-7:50 p.m.)Addison Rae (5:30 - 6:20 p.m.)Jaqck Glame (4:15-5:20 p.m.) KAROL G (9:55 pm)Young Thug (7:50-8:40 p.m.)Major Lazer (6:10-7:10 p.m.)Wet Leg (4:45-5:30 p.m.)Tijuana Panthers (3:40-4:15 p.m.)Gabe Real (2:45-3:30 p.m.) Photo by Arturo Holmes/Getty Images for Coachella Who wasn't in Indio this weekend? Coachella is always one of the key moments in the musical year, but in 2026, with Bieberchella and Karol G's history making headlining slot, the longstanding Indio festival felt especially major. Alongside the stacked official lineup, the festival featured a formidable list of surprise guest performances. From throwback moments — like M.I.A. joining Major Lazer for "Paper Planes" — to timely headline-makers — like HUNTR/X singing "Golden" with KATSEYE — it was a "link and build" marathon. Some FADER favorites even made surprised appearances, like pianist Precious Renee Tucker who joined PinkPantheress on stage. See below for some highlight surprise guests from a stacked Coachella 2026 weekend one. PinkPantheress brought out pianist Precious Renee Tucker, Thundercat, The Dare, HorsegiirL, and Tyriq Whithers (who played "Romeo") Justin Bieber featured Tems, Dijon, The Kid LAROI, WizKid, and Hailey Bieber at his headlining set KATSEYE performed the Oscar-winning "Golden" with HUNTR/X (EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and REI AMI) Sabrina Carpenter included Hollywood royalty Will Ferrell and Susan Sarandon in her headline performance Underscores came out for "Harvest Sky" with oklou Camila Cabello and Young Thug threw it back with "Havana" M.I.A performed "Paper Planes" with Major Lazer Karol G celebrated her historic headlining slot with Becky G, Mariah Angeliq, and Wisin Swae Lee sang with Jhené Aiko, Nav, Rich the Kid, and his baby Jennifer Lopez performed in a sparkly look with David Guetta Porter Robinson joined Gen F alum Ninajirachi at her Coachella debut Thumbnail photo credit: Arturo Holmes/Getty Images for Coachella
